Name: OhoDavi Anime Portraits for Horny Bachelors
Author: bezajel
Description:
[b][size=5]What is this mod for?
[/size][/b]
This mod allows you to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]OhoDavi's anime portraits[/url] with Girafarig's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2564]Horny Bachelors[/url] mod.

This mod has two components:
1. OhoDavi portraits edited for use with Horny Bachelors;
2. Content Patcher mod that allows you to use anime/alt portrait mods without overwriting HB portraits.


[size=5][b]What other mods are required?
[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] - yeah you probably already have these I guess 🤷‍♀️

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2564]Horny Bachelors[/url] - you must have HB installed for my mod to work. Please choose the version of my mod that corresponds to the version of HB you have downloaded (full version or no cum bottles version).

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]CMCT[/url] - you need this installed so the mod can draw on your config settings from Horny Bachelors to determine which portraits to show.

OhoDavi's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Stardewvalley Anime Mods[/url] are not technically required, but you probably want these for a consistent style across the game. If you wish to use another portrait mod, please see below under compatibility.


[b][size=5]How to Install?
[/size][/b]
1. Download and extract (unzip) the mod.
2. Move the extracted mod into your Mods folder.
3. Profit!


[size=5][b]Config Settings
[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] is recommended for configuration settings, but you can also edit the config.json if you prefer.

EnableMod: [b]true[/b]|false - Turns this mod on or off.

AddHarveyMoustache: [b]true[/b]|false - Adds a moustache to Harvey's OhoDavi portrait, optional for consistency with Horny Bachelor's dialogue. (If you leave it off, Harvey will refer to his moustache despite being clean shaven).

NakedWinter: true|[b]false[/b] - You will need to select here if you want the men to be naked in Winter. This was the only setting I was unable to import directly from Horny Bachelors.


[size=5][b]Compatibility
[/b][/size]
Designed and tested for:

✅ Stardew Valley 1.6﻿.15

✅ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2564]Horny Bachelors[/url] 1.6.5
✅ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]OhoDavi Anime Portraits[/url] (CP version) 1.6.2

✅ Should be generally compatible with other CP mods that do not alter portraits.


[b]Other Portrait Mods:[/b]

✅ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits Inspired by Dong[/url]﻿ 1.6.9
✅ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23738]Nyapu's (Unofficial) Portraits for HB[/url] 1.2

if you want to use the Nyapu style portraits for Horny Bachelors:

1. Replace the Portraits folder in [b]this[/b] mod with the Portraits folder from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23738]Nyapu portraits for HB[/url] mod.
2. install the CP version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu portraits inspired by Dong[/url].


⚠️ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] (Legacy Version 1.0.1)

This mod's portraits will take precedence over seasonal cute portraits, but HB's sprites will be overwritten by seasonal cute. This means:
[list]
[*]the sprites might be wearing a different outfit to the portraits
[*]the men won't walk around naked
[*]jerking off will still be mostly visible but will glitch
[/list]
﻿I might be able to include a fix for sprite issues in a future version, if anyone wants that.
OhoDavi portraits for Seasonal Cute can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22876]here[/url]﻿. Pay attention to which version you download.If you want to use Seasonal Cute with Girafarig's vanilla style Horny Bachelor portraits:
1. Replace the Portraits folder in [b]this[/b] mod with the Portraits folder from HB (leave a copy in the HB mod as well).
2. Make sure that you install the [b]Legacy[/b] version of seasonal cute.

For best results, disable seasonal cute for the bachelors and other men. It's fine to enable it for other NPCs not included in HB.


❌ Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic (current version 6.0.0+)

This mod does not work with the latest version of Seasonal Cute, as that adds new seasonal portraits rather than editing vanilla ones. Disable seasonal cute for the bachelors and other men. It's fine to enable it for other NPCs not included in HB.


✅ Other vanilla style portrait mods - ﻿If you are using another mod that changes portraits, and want to prevent it from overwriting Girafarig's Horny Bachelor portraits, you can replace the Portraits folder in [b]this[/b] mod with the Portraits folder from HB. (Leave a copy in the original HB mod as well).

Limitations:
[list]
[*]This will only work for [b]portraits[/b] - HB sprites will still be overwritten if the other mod changes these (see notes on seasonal cute legacy version, above).
[/list]

[b]Other Adult/NSFW Mods:
[/b]
✅ This mod should be compatible with other mods that work with HB:

✅ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10844]Horny Festivals[/url]
✅ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10532]Valley Girls[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31425]OhoDavi portraits for VG[/url]
✅ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23623]Lustdew Valley[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31517]OhoDavi portraits for LV[/url]
✅ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27635]Xtardew Valley - Sexperimental Edition[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29854]OhoDavi portraits for Xtardew-SE[/url]
﻿✅ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20277]Nude Girls[/url]﻿ (no OhoDavi portraits yet)
